commercial_thesis.problem_statement: Market demand surging around 'GPT-6 Astra'. Developers need instant, zero-setup data formatting without subscribing to expensive paid cloud gateways.
commercial_thesis.solution_specification: Turnkey Python micro-engine and FastAPI compatible data standardizer with zero dependencies.
commercial_thesis.target_demographic: SaaS builders, autonomous agents, and data engineering pipelines.
commercial_thesis.monetization_vector: Freemium API on Direct API ($0 for 10k calls, $9.99/mo for 250k calls) + Static GitHub Pages programmatic SEO hub.
